reviewNotes: Reviewed all 20 cards and 103 exported speech keys against data/pages81-tuna.json vocabulary/furigana. Verified tuna cut names including せぶし, はらぶし, てんみ, おにく, わかれみ, せのだいみ and ひれうえ. Resolved duplicated 分かれ身/ヒレ上 and residual kanji. Corrected contextual 何を to なにお and positional 上手側 to かみてがわ; page 81 spoken as ぺーじはちじゅういち. Checked topic は, directional へ and object を in context while preserving lexical はらぶし/はらいちばん/はいそく and lexical しゅうへん. Retained loanword long vowels and replaced sequence arrows with spoken pauses. Sentences, questions and explanations use Nova generation speed 1.0; vocabulary and very short noun fragments/groups use 0.85. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
